# Documentation Guidance

- Distinguish current implementation, approved requirement, proposed design, external dependency, and open decision.
- Link documents with relative Markdown links. Avoid duplicating rules; point to [Master Production Rules](../../MASTER_PRODUCTION_RULES.md).
- Do not claim tests, resources, integrations, permissions, or deployments exist without evidence. Date material decisions and name source basis.
- Preserve ATSugg terminology and meaning; do not assume its technical restrictions apply to the new platform.
- Keep scope and status current in [Current State](../../docs/CURRENT_STATE.md).
